tools.name: Create a Cube
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
cmds.polyCube()

tools.name: Zero Transforms
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
cmds.makeIdentity(apply=True, t=1, r=1, s=1)

tools.name: Tool Registry Editor
tools.script:
import bmaya.maya_ui.tool_registry_editor as tre
tre.show_ui()

tools.name: Rig Manager
tools.script:
import bmaya.maya_ui.rigManager.rigManager as rm
rm.run()

tools.name: Tool Menu Editor
tools.script:
import bmaya.maya_ui.tool_views.tool_menu
bmaya.maya_ui.tool_views.tool_menu.show_menu_editor_ui()

tools.name: Create Joint at Center
tools.script:
import bmaya.maya.rigging.joint as jointUtils
jointUtils.create_joint_at_selection_center()

tools.name: Orient to World
tools.script:
import bmaya.maya.rigging.joints as jointUtils
jointUtils.orient_to_world(cmds.ls(sl=1, type='joint'))

tools.name: Orient to Mesh
tools.script:
import bmaya.maya.rigging.joints as jointUtils
sel = cmds.ls(sl=1)
jointUtils.orient_to_mesh(sel[0:-1], sel[-1])

tools.name: Reset Module
tools.script:
from bmaya.maya.rigging import rigTools
rigTools.reset_module(cmds.ls(sl=1)[0])

tools.name: Reset Character
tools.script:
from bmaya.maya.rigging import rigTools
rigTools.reset_character(cmds.ls(sl=1)[0])

tools.name: Key All
tools.script:
from bmaya.maya.rigging import rigTools
rigTools.key_all(cmds.ls(sl=1)[0])

tools.name: Match Ik to FK
tools.script:
from bmaya.maya.rigging import rigTools
rigTools.match_ik_to_fk(cmds.ls(sl=1)[0])

tools.name: Match FK to IK
tools.script:
from bmaya.maya.rigging import rigTools
rigTools.match_fk_to_ik(cmds.ls(sl=1)[0])

tools.name: Print Joint Markup
Remove Joint Markup
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
joints = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='joint')
if not joints:
    raise RuntimeError('Select joints.')
cmds.rigJointMarkup(*joints, remove=True)

tools.name: Select All Controls
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
roots = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='rigRootModule')
if len(roots) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Select one rig root (rigRootModule).')
cmds.select(cmds.getRigControls(roots[0]), replace=True)

tools.name: Select Mirror Controls
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
controls = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='rigControlNode')
if not controls:
    raise RuntimeError('Select rig controls.')
cmds.select([cmds.getRigMirrorControl(c) for c in controls], replace=True)

tools.name: Mirror Shapes Left to Right
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
roots = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='rigRootModule')
if len(roots) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Select one rig root (rigRootModule).')
cmds.mirrorRigControlShapes(roots[0], leftToRight=True)

tools.name: Mirror Shapes Right to Left
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
roots = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='rigRootModule')
if len(roots) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Select one rig root (rigRootModule).')
cmds.mirrorRigControlShapes(roots[0], leftToRight=False)

tools.name: Save Control Shapes...
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
roots = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='rigRootModule')
if len(roots) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Select one rig root (rigRootModule).')
path = cmds.fileDialog2(caption='Save Control Shapes', fileFilter='Shape files (*.json)', fileMode=0)
if path:
    cmds.saveRigControlShapes(roots[0], file=path[0])

tools.name: Load Control Shapes...
tools.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
roots = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='rigRootModule')
if len(roots) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Select one rig root (rigRootModule).')
path = cmds.fileDialog2(caption='Load Control Shapes', fileFilter='Shape files (*.json)', fileMode=1)
if path:
    cmds.loadRigControlShapes(roots[0], file=path[0])
